description: A player crafts a Daylight Detector with the Chronite recipe at a crafting table: the grid is filled slot by slot (glass on top, Chronite Shards in the middle, wooden slabs at the bottom) and the result is shift-clicked.
steps: execute in minecraft:overworld run forceload add 32 0 47 15
execute in minecraft:overworld run fill 36 200 4 44 200 12 minecraft:white_concrete
execute in minecraft:overworld run setblock 40 201 10 minecraft:crafting_table

steps.note: The crafting table grid: three glass on the top row, three Chronite Shards in the middle row, three oak slabs on the bottom row, and a Daylight Detector in the result slot.

steps: execute in minecraft:overworld run forceload remove 32 0 47 15
